items.title: Create a GitHub test organisation for Narthex
items.lead: Later tasks need a throwaway organisation to test sign-in and the GitHub App against. Creating it is an outward action.
bullets: The walking skeleton (T-018-02) and the sign-in spike (T-010-01) both run against it.
Use an organisation with no real repositories, so tests can create and delete freely.
Write the organisation's name in features/F-001-workspace/notes.md; no secret is involved.
options: I'll create it and note its name
Use an organisation I already own (name it)

items.title: Register a GitHub OAuth app for sign-in, with a localhost callback
items.lead: The sign-in spike (T-010-01) needs a real GitHub OAuth app. Its callback points at localhost until a hosted address exists.
bullets: Register it under the test organisation, once that exists.
The callback URL is a localhost address; T-017-04 later files an item to point it at the hosted address.
Put the client id in features/F-001-workspace/notes.md. Put the client secret in the secret store, never in the repo.
options: I'll register it and note the client id

items.title: Register a test GitHub App on the test organisation
items.lead: The git-host connector and the walking skeleton need a GitHub App they can install on the test organisation.
bullets: Register it under the test organisation, once that exists.
Put the app id in features/F-001-workspace/notes.md. Put the private key and webhook secret in the secret store.
Install it only on the test organisation, never on a real one.
options: I'll register it and note the app id
